name: Grok in Google Workspace
desc: One Google Workspace add-on that puts Grok beside your open file.
desc_zh: 一个 Google Workspace 加载项，让 Grok 停在 Sheets、Slides 和 Docs 中打开的文件旁。
solves: Leaving the document to ask a question breaks the thread; the add-on answers against the file you are already editing.
solves_zh: 为问个问题而离开文档会打断思路；加载项就着你正在编辑的文件作答。
best_for: You are editing a budget in Sheets and want the numbers explained without switching windows.
best_for_zh: 正在 Sheets 里改预算，想让数字被解释清楚又不想切窗口时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — x.ai/news directory; channel A Google Workspace Marketplace listing）。 One add-on covering three applications, unlike the four separate Microsoft Office add-ins. The Google Workspace Marketplace listing URL is linked from the official announcement. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：嵌在办公软件里的助手，与账本对同类功能的分类一致。 首次公开日期来源：https://x.ai/news/introducing-google-workspace-addon
